annotations.text:
A — SLOT GRID

The array cell is the atom. Examples are drawn as the indexed cells they actually are; test cases are a strip of numbered slots. Dense, structural, everything on a visible module.

Bet: this subject is about position and state, so make the geometry literal.

B — QUIET STAGE

The problem is reading material, so it is set like reading — serif, 20px, generous. Two panes instead of four. The coach is a floating companion over the work, not a fourth column.

Bet: one thing at a time beats everything at once.

Same functional spec, two opposite bets. No palette, type or design system was supplied — every visual decision here is fresh.

Both carry: module nav, problem brief with worked example and constraints, four content tabs, language switch, editor, run, per-case results with in/expected/got, and the coaching thread with a run verdict.
